name: fsp-new-injuries
description: Issue #693 regression: during First Session with an empty injuries.json, reporting several brand-new injuries in one turn must fire injury_flag (not injury_event, which is now update/resolve-only and requires a real flag_id) and must not crash the write path. NOTE: this eval harness calls askGemini() with soul: "" (see this file's header comment), so it cannot exercise the real prompt guidance in platform/soul/B_engine.md - it only proves the schema/write path accepts the shape. The live bug (Gemini inventing a flag_id like "left_knee_acl" for a new injury under the old single-field design, which then couldn't be found in an empty injuries.json and threw) and the fix (splitting into injury_flag/injury_event) were verified separately against the real composed SOUL text, not via this harness.
